what: Moving the cursor over the footer’s giant wordmark sets each letter’s weight p by its distance d from the cursor = e^(−d²/(320×160)) is assigned, so the closer a letter is, the more it stretches 1+.45p vertically and 1+.18p horizontally from the bottom, and lifts 18p px up (.4s power2.out). When the cursor leaves the panel, all spring back wobbling with .7s elastic.out(1, .6) — signboard letters you stroke by hand

options.scale-y: Vertical stretch of the nearest letter, default .45
options.[data-fx-part=char]: Text chunks (if none, the text is split by character)
options.[data-fx-part=zone]: Wider board for reading the cursor (put on an ancestor to react across that whole board, original uses the whole Footer)
